citations.claim: cart exceeds track at first violating step
cart already near end one step before with outward velocity
system energy rising due to controller work while drifting

counterfactual.change: changed initial x from 0.4367 to 0.0 only; cart no longer starts near edge with outward velocity so weak position correction suffices and no violation in 261 steps

explanation: State-feedback controller prioritizes pole balance (theta stays ~0.08 rad, margin ~0.72) with only weak cart-position correction (~0.8N). Starting from x=0.44 with v=0.31 outward, cart drifts monotonically (x=1.06 at step 130, 2.24 at step 250, 2.39 at step 260) and exits at step 261, while force remains far below limit. Zeroing initial x removes the failure.

violation.detail: cart at x=2.404 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The cart is at the far right end of the track with the pole still nearly upright. Across steps 258 to 261 it drifts further right and exits the track boundary.
